Liam — thanks for sending and for the clear summary. Quick responses below.

1) Documents we need to clear procurement gate: 
   - Signed Form W-8BEN-E (you already submitted — thanks).
   - Proof of bank account in company name (bank letter on official letterhead).
   - Certificate of incorporation or a company registration extract (for entity name matching).
   - UBO / beneficial ownership declaration if applicable (small checklist item).

2) Timeline to PO: once we have the three items above and our tax team confirms the FATCA status on the W-8, procurement can typically issue a PO within 2 business days. If there are questions from tax, it can extend to 5 business days.

Next steps for you: please upload the bank letter and the incorporation extract to our secure upload portal (link below). If you prefer, we can accept notarized PDF copies via DocuSign.

Secure upload: https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/receive/ABC123
Procurement checklist (attached): procurement_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Kimberly — looping you in to pick up the PO creation once tax confirms.

All — quick tax verification notes from Ben (Redwood tax ops).

Thanks for the W-8, Liam. A couple of things tax will check before we mark the file cleared: 
- Confirm that the W-8BEN-E is physically signed and dated (scanned signature acceptable, notarized preferred when outside EU for US payors).
- Confirm FATCA chapter/status box is completed (we need an explicit chapter reference).
- Bank letter should include account number, account name matching Camino Therapeutics Ltd., and the bank's contact info on letterhead (signed by bank officer).
- For UK entities we often request a company house registration extract (no older than 3 months).

If you can provide notarized scans of W-8 + bank letter and upload to the secure portal, I can run an expedited review and clear the file the same business day. Once cleared, procurement (Kimberly) can request PO generation.
